records.claim_text: 6PPD-Q exposure causes a NAFLD/NASH-like hepatic phenotype.
records.protocol: Vehicle and at least two pre-specified 6PPD-Q exposure levels on the selected diet background; record route, dose, duration, sex, age, randomization and blinding.
limitations: No animal experiment or ethics approval has been completed.
Dose and sample size require literature, tolerability and power calculation.

records.claim_text: The selected target mediates the hepatic effect of 6PPD-Q.
records.protocol: Pre-specified target loss- or gain-of-function with vehicle and 6PPD-Q arms, followed by restoration or rescue; use genotype-appropriate controls and blinded phenotyping.
limitations: Target identity must be frozen before experiment execution.
No perturbation or rescue data exist.

records.claim_text: 6PPD-Q directly binds or engages the selected target.
records.protocol: Use recombinant protein SPR, ITC or MST plus a cellular binding assay such as CETSA or thermal shift with negative controls and orthogonal confirmation when feasible.
limitations: Docking and MD are not direct binding evidence.
No wet-lab binding or engagement data exist.
